exposure: Resuscitative endovascular balloon occlusion of the aorta (REBOA)
cohort: 143 patients with postpartum hemorrhage who underwent REBOA
finding: This study described the characteristics and outcomes of patients with postpartum hemorrhage who underwent REBOA, finding that the most common cause of postpartum hemorrhage was atonic postpartum hemorrhage and the in-hospital mortality was 7%.
mod_finding: Among patients who delivered at hospitals in which REBOA was performed, 70.9% delivered via cesarean delivery.
gest_age: 38.2% of patients who delivered at hospitals where REBOA was performed experienced preterm births
